hero.title: Selling Trash Made Easy
hero.description: We are here to recycle domestic waste (Non-B3) to create a better Indonesia.

features.title: Why Kepul.id?
features.sell_trash_description: Sell recyclable waste (non-B3), register your waste and get cash and protect the environment.
features.charity_trash_description: Donate recyclable waste for social purposes, contribute your waste to trusted charity programs.
features.kepul_point_description: Deliver and sell recyclable waste independently at your nearest Kepul Point.
features.business_event_description: Manage and arrange recyclable waste collection from your company or event through Kepul.
features.zero_waste_school_description: Empowering school students to earn extra cash or savings with recyclable waste.
features.staple_food_trash_description: Helping people get various necessities at lower prices with discounts from selling recyclable waste.

howto.title: Selling Trash Made Easier!
howto.description: In just four steps, you can profit from selling recyclable waste.
howto.step_one_desc: Before you sell recyclable waste, make sure it's sorted!
howto.step_two_desc: Open the Kepul app, take a photo and fill in the information about the recyclable waste you're selling.
howto.step_three_desc: After you upload it to the Kepul app, our driver is ready to pick it up at your home.
howto.step_four_desc: After the transaction is successful, we will transfer the money to your account.
